summary.text: Jane Aman is the Democratic candidate for the Florida House of Representatives, District 37, in the November 3, 2026 general election, against Republican Robert Allen Prater; there is no incumbent in the race.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as an educator and organizer who is a full-time lecturer at the University of Central Florida and a former Seminole County high school teacher.

paragraphs.text: Aman earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Texas at El Paso in 2016 and a graduate degree and Ph.D. from the University of Texas at Austin in 2020 and 2023, according to Ballotpedia.
She said in her survey that her Ph.D. is in English and that she began her teaching career at Austin.

Before her doctorate, Aman said she organized for reproductive rights with Unite for Reproductive and Gender Equity (now All Above All) and volunteered with the Borderland Rainbow Center in El Paso and the Center Against Sexual and Family Violence.

She listed affordable housing and lower property insurance rates, fully funded public schools with higher pay for teachers and staff, and expanding Medicaid and preventative health care as her key campaign messages.
